effects.effect: At the start of your [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn), you can end any [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) [condition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/condition) on you. Additionally, you have a double [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on [tests](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) made to escape being confined or imprisoned.
